$comment: Vinara's leaders and elections (docs/vinara-sources.md §9–10, docs/vinara-method.md 'Leaders and elections'). Leaders and elections are read from two Wikipedia lists each run; what the site shows is the snapshot approved in politics_approved.json, and any difference is reported for review first. `names` maps a country to its name in each list where it differs from ours. `executive_overrides` replaces the list's executive office where it names a body rather than a person. `elections.decides` overrides the rule for which election decides the executive (presidential where the executive president is elected; otherwise legislative); `none` means no national election is held. Every note carries the exact words it rests on, re-checked against the source each run.
